idea: the desk's zone: a red candle in the midst of rising greens (a green in the midst of falling reds) - the one bar where the run paused; when price comes back to it, it holds and the run resumes
origin: bar r is red (close < open); the K bars before it and the K bars after it are all green (close > open); known at r + K. Shorts: the same on the flipped chart (a green among reds)
zone: [low(r), open(r)] - the red candle's body and lower wick; stop low(r) - 0.1 ATR(r); any stop fill takes 0.05 ATR of slippage

families.K2_BIG: K = 2 and the red body is at least 0.5 ATR(r) (a real pullback bar, not a doji)
families.ANY (baseline): any red candle, no run around it

activation: after r + K, price must trade 1 ATR(r) above the zone top before trading below the zone's bottom, within 60 bars of r; the zone is live from the next bar
entry: a limit buy at the zone top on the first bar, within 20 days of going live, that reaches it (at the open if it opens below); one trade per zone

exits.E1 (primary): a 2-ATR(r) trail behind completed bars' best high after the fill bar
exits.X2: a fixed 2R target (on the fill bar only if it closes there)

R: against the nominal risk zone top - stop, net of costs (Binance 0.07% of price; MT5 and Deriv the broker's spread floor; walks the real series' cost in ATR units); the zone's risk in ATR is recorded
nulls: iid walk matched to each series
GARCH(1,1) walk with the series' sigma
both 256 sub-steps a bar, real timestamps
data: Binance perpetuals (12), MT5 (10 markets), Deriv synthetics (15; reported apart, never pooled), 1h, 4h, 1d
passes_if: R > 0 with day-bootstrap 90% interval above 0, positive before and after 2024-01-01, above ANY on the same data, and above K3 on both walks
also: P(N R) for N in 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10 against 1/(N+1); the same on MT5 and Deriv
